blocking_findings: The exact immutable test_runner.py cannot run from the snapshot because it references a missing sibling filename; it exits with FileNotFoundError before executing fixtures.
Batch/log/experiment namespace claims and initial status publication occur before the protected try/except, so partial pre-worker failures bypass durable failure publication.

A success/final_evidence.json with status local_probe_done is published before the terminal commit; a later terminal/finalization error can publish failure evidence alongside this success-looking artifact.
There is no post-evaluator revalidation of approval, evaluator, frozen inputs, targets/reconstructions, or artifact hashes before terminal publication.
Global-lock acquisition lacks full pre-open and post-flock inode/type/mode/owner/link-count closure; failure occupancy uses exists rather than lexists; WSL CUDA exclusion lacks a /dev/dxg fallback.
Pending and failure outcomes do not explicitly preserve candidate_eligible=false and official_followup_authorized=false in all machine-readable evidence.
